newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Gas oil retreats with London.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Gas oil retreats with London.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps eased slightly late afternoon on Monday after they had firmed earlier on India's bumper award of February diesel, industry sources said.
January gas oil was last quoted at $31.90/$32.05 per barrel, down from $32.05/$32.25 earlier but still slightly higher than Friday's $31.80/$31.95.
February was last quoted at $30.80/$30.95, down from $30.95/$31.15 earlier and up from $30.75/$30.90 Friday.
January gas oil swaps traded this afternoon at $32.05 a barrel while February traded at $31.05 and $30.90 a barrel, brokers said.
In the morning January was bid to a high of $32.25 but traded at $32.00 and $32.10 while February bids rose to a peak of $31.15, brokers said.
Traders said the market gave up earlier gains because of weaker crude values and a softer gas oil futures opening on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
January gas oil on the IPE fell $2.75 on Friday to $215.00 per tonne and on Monday extended the losses a further $3.00 to $212.00 in early trading.
February Brent on the IPE closed down 52 cents at $23.46 a barrel on Friday, and at 0945 GMT was last traded on SIMEX down seven cents at $23.39.

The initial support for the swaps market came after Indian Oil Corp's (IOC) awarded 720,000 tonnes of high speed diesel for arrival in February. As of Friday, traders had expected an award between 500,000 to 700,000 tonnes.
The jet fuel/gas oil spread or regrade was largely unchanged in quiet trade after recent purchases from North Asia for the winter.
January regrade bids were notionally indicated at $1.40 a barrel after trading on Friday at $1.475, brokers said.
The rest of the product swaps were down on the back of the lower crude values.
January naphtha indications were a notional $23.95/$24.10 per barrel, slightly lower than Friday's $24.00/$24.20.
January fuel oil was quoted at $119.25/$120.50 per tonne, down from Friday's $120.25/$121.00.
